title: 각종분쟁조정위원회등의조정조서등에대한집행문부여에관한규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:2:0:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 2 (Scope of Application)
Except as otherwise specially prescribed by other statutes or regulations, the form of applications for granting writs of execution and procedures for granting them in respect of records of settlement, mediation records, arbitration records, mediation documents and other documents, regardless of name, prepared by mediation committees, deliberative committees, arbitration committees, arbitral tribunals or other dispute resolution bodies other than courts or court mediation committees (hereinafter referred to as "mediation committees") and having the same effect as a judicial settlement (hereinafter referred to as "records") shall be governed by these Rules insofar as their nature permits.
